Product: Abiomed Impella CP Set with SmartAssist (10th Generation) containing affected 14Fr Low Profile Introducer Kits. Product Codes: 1000413, 1000834.
Reason for recall: Potential for thrombus formation during prolonged use of the introducer.
Recalling firm: Abiomed, Inc. (MA)
Quantity: 168 units

Under FDA's three recall classes, which class is this recall?

criteria.A: Class II: using or being exposed to the device may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences, or the chance of serious harm is remote
criteria.B: Class I: there is a reasonable probability that using or being exposed to the device will cause serious adverse health consequences or death
criteria.C: Class III: using or being exposed to the device is not likely to cause any adverse health consequences

FDA medical device enforcement report (recall classification removed):

Product: Curaplex Cricothyrotomy Field Kit with Instruments, Kwik Cric MVP, 6.0mm, Item Number 351631i-A. The kit provides healthcare professionals with an assortment of supplies to perform a cricothyrotomy.
Reason for recall: It was determined that the Endotracheal Tube Holder included in certain kits is not compatible with a cricothyrotomy procedure, leaving practitioners without the necessary means to secure the inserted endotracheal tube.
Recalling firm: Sarnova HC, Llc (OH)
Quantity: 15 kits

Which recall classification did FDA assign, given the health risk the problem poses?

criteria.A: Class I: there is a reasonable probability that using or being exposed to the device will cause serious adverse health consequences or death
criteria.B: Class III: using or being exposed to the device is not likely to cause any adverse health consequences
criteria.C: Class II: using or being exposed to the device may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences, or the chance of serious harm is remote
